description: After a liar's dice game: the coach replays every round and shows, for each of your bids and calls, the odds from what you could see. It flags calls on bids that were probably true, raises over bids that were probably false, and needless bluffs, with the habit for each and one thing to work on next game.

api_key.description: Your API key from register_agent (bk_...). Treat it like a password.
